name: Koigawara Mia
source:
Formed Sub-Couple 03 with [url=/c128229]Tokiya Rei[/url].

[url=/c125790]Kokoro[/url]'s best friend, self-proclaimed to be the prettiest and most popular girl in the class. Indeed, she is cute.
Determined to be the center of attention, she spares no effort. Although she acts all cutesy, she has a bad personality and a sharp tongue.
All she cares about is being popular, so she is actually an inexpert who has no idea what it is like to be in love.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.asa-pro.com/koibana/character/subcouples.html]official website[/url]]
